titus.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ …

titus.1.p1.b2.text: To Titus, my true child in our common faith:

titus.1.p1.b3.text: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

titus.1.p2.b1.text: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished …

titus.1.p2.b2.text: … and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

titus.1.p2.b3.text: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers …

titus.1.p3.b1.text: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach …

titus.1.p3.b2.text: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.

titus.1.p3.b3.text: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.

titus.1.p4.b1.text: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,

titus.1.p4.b2.text: … who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households …

titus.1.p4.b3.text: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”

titus.1.p5.b1.text: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith

titus.1.p5.b2.text: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. …

titus.1.p5.b3.text: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. …
